description: Science and practice of protecting biodiversity and natural systems

discipline_overview.definition: Applied scientific study aiming to protect biological diversity
discipline_overview.founded: 1985 as distinct discipline; Michael Soulé is considered founder
discipline_overview.mission_oriented: Crisis discipline; must often act on incomplete information
discipline_overview.interdisciplinary: Combines ecology, genetics, economics, sociology, policy

principles.minimum_viable_population: Minimum number of individuals needed for long-term survival; typically >500 (genetic), >50 (short-term)
principles.extinction_debt: Species committed to extinction due to habitat loss but not yet gone

categories.ia_ib: Strict nature reserve/wilderness area; minimal human impact
categories.vi: Protected area with sustainable resource use

protected_areas.coverage: 17% of land and 10% of ocean protected (2023); 30x30 target by 2030
protected_areas.effectiveness: Well-managed reserves significantly reduce species loss
protected_areas.gaps: Many areas 'paper parks'; lack enforcement and funding

conservation_strategies.in_situ: Conservation in natural habitat; preferred approach
conservation_strategies.ex_situ: Conservation outside natural habitat; zoos, seed banks, captive breeding

seed_banks.svalbard: Svalbard Global Seed Vault; 1.3 million varieties; Norwegian Arctic; opened 2008
seed_banks.purpose: Insurance against crop loss from disasters, climate change, conflicts

conservation_strategies.captive_breeding: California condor recovered from 27 wild birds in 1987 to 500+ today
conservation_strategies.wildlife_corridors: Linkages between habitat patches; reduce isolation; allow gene flow

rewilding.definition: Restore large-scale natural processes and wilderness

genetics_in_conservation.genetic_diversity: Essential for adaptability; bottlenecks reduce it
genetics_in_conservation.inbreeding_depression: Reduced fitness in small isolated populations
genetics_in_conservation.genetic_rescue: Introducing individuals from other populations to increase genetic diversity
genetics_in_conservation.dna_barcoding: Identify species from small tissue samples; track illegal wildlife trade
genetics_in_conservation.deextinction: Using genetics to resurrect extinct species; mammoth, thylacine projects controversial

international_frameworks.convention_biological_diversity: CBD; 1992; 196 parties; main global biodiversity treaty
international_frameworks.kunming_montreal: 2022 global biodiversity framework; 30x30 target; $200B/year for biodiversity
international_frameworks.cites: Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species; controls wildlife trade
international_frameworks.world_heritage: UNESCO sites; protecting outstanding natural value
